name: Star-Lord

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.

howToPlay: Star-Lord için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Tech sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Tactician
As blows are exchanged, Star-Lord familiarizes with opponents' techniques, increasing Attack by [99.73 - 595.12] for each hit of the Combo Meter to maximum of 400 hits.
Star-Lord gains [27.78 - 143.38] Block Proficiency for every hit of his opponent's Combo Meter.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: 11% chance to gain a Fury Buff for 6.5 seconds, granting +[4,487.85] Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Deals 20% bonus damage when striking a charging enemy.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Star-Lord's Element Gun selects one element at random each time it fires. Each element has a different effect when it strikes the opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Star-Lord's Element Gun selects one element at random each time it fires. Each element has a different effect when it strikes the opponent.

abilitySections.title: Element Gun Effects
content: FIRE: Breaks the opponent's Armor, reducing Armor Rating by [1,758.2] for 8 seconds.
AIR: Shocks the opponent, dealing [19,048.43] Energy Damage over 6 seconds. Shocks ignore Physical Resistance, but not Energy Resistance.
WATER: Drains up to 50% of the opponent's Max Power.
EARTH: Places a Heal Block on the opponent, stopping all healing effects for 11 seconds.
